童子の戯れは、人知れず災いを退ける: The child's playful antics ward off calamity unseen
消えない未練の魂を宿したもの。: Imbued with a soul of unextinguishable regret.
未練は残雪となり、とけゆく時を待つ: Regrets turn to lingering snow, awaiting the time to melt away
沼女の魂を宿したもの。: Imbued with the soul of a Swamp Woman.
沼には沈む。刃も、術でさえも: All sink into the swamp—blades, and spells alike
迷い森の雪女の魂を宿したもの。: Imbued with the soul of a Yuki-onna from the Lost Forest.
氷は永遠の眠りの褥となる: Ice becomes the bed of eternal slumber
命刻山の鬼の魂を宿したもの。: Imbued with the soul of an ogre from Mt. Meikoku.
悪気はない。お気に入りの場所を守るためだ: No ill intent. It is simply to protect its favorite spot
レーセ川の先導の魂を宿したもの。: Imbued with the soul of a guide from the River Lese.
常夜の冥府は罪なき魂を祝福する: The underworld of eternal night blesses innocent souls
龍の乳母の魂を宿したもの。: Imbued with the soul of a dragon's wet nurse.
乳母は奥義と呼べる技を持たないためか\nこれに技能は宿されず、ただ能力のみを\n:
Perhaps because the wet nurse lacks techniques worthy of being called Ultimates,
no skill is contained within this—it simply drastically
increases parameters
秘せる落胤の魂を宿したもの。: Imbued with the soul of a hidden illegitimate child.
穢れた祈り。あまりにも独りよがりだった: A defiled prayer. It was far too self-serving
四魂怪異の内、三つの魂を宿したもの。: Imbued with three of the souls from the Four-Souls Anomaly.
三つの魂は己の奥義の強さを説き: The three souls argue the supremacy of their respective Ultimate Skills
そうして喧嘩になっているようだ: And so, they seem to be locked in a quarrel
決着はつかず、技能は何も得られないが: With no conclusion reached, no skill is granted,
代わりに生命力を大きく高める: but in return, max HP is greatly increased
四魂怪異の魂を宿したもの。: Imbued with the souls of the Four-Souls Anomaly.
四つの魂は己の奥義の強さを説き: The four souls argue the supremacy of their respective Ultimate Skills
宝箱に潜む少女のような魔物\n自らを露にした者に襲い掛かり\n住処の中へと引きず:
A monster resembling a young girl lurking inside a treasure chest.
It pounces upon those who expose themselves
and drags them into its lair.

There are usually victims near a trap.
One would do well to observe carefully.
少女と箱は別の個体である\nすなわち、この魔物は二人一組なのだ\n\n稀に逸れる:
The girl and the box are separate entities.
In other words, this monster operates as a pair.

On rare occasions, they may stray apart.
男性は、罠だと知ってもこの箱を開けてしまう\n内側にいる魔物にマナを奪われるとき:
Men open this box even when knowing it is a trap.
Because when having their mana drained by the monster inside,
they are granted supreme ecstasy.
沖に浮かび上がる火の怪異\n東国ではありふれた存在で\n時折火花を散らし、人を驚:
A fire anomaly rising off the coast
A common sight in the eastern lands
It occasionally scatters sparks, startling people
こともなげに浮遊する面妖な蛸\n無軌道に漂うその様から\n死後の魂に例えられる:
A strange octopus floating nonchalantly
Drifting aimlessly without a course
It is often compared to a soul after death
散乱した骨が連なってできた存在\n蛇のようだが、蛇の骨の魔物ではない\n\n連な:
A creature formed from scattered bones linked together
It resembles a snake, but is not a snake-bone monster

The reason they link together is unknown
Perhaps the corpses found a sense of unity among themselves
小さな塵が溜まり煤となるように\n闇もまた、塊になることがある\n\n存在する場:
Just as tiny dust gathers to become soot
Darkness too can form into clumps

Wherever it exists becomes dusty
It is best to cover your nose and mouth
無邪気な様子の小柄な屍\nかつての不幸など忘れている\n\n普通ではない膂力が物:
A small corpse with an innocent demeanor
Having long forgotten its past misfortunes

Its unnatural strength tells the story
That it is no longer human
鬼面柴組の隊士\n夜寄せ塔にて遭遇した\n\nひたすらに前だけを向く善良な人物\:
An officer of the Kimen-Shibagumi
Encountered at Yoyose Tower

A virtuous person who looks relentlessly forward
Which is precisely why conflicts sometimes arise
幾度転べど立ち上がる: No matter how many times she falls, she stands back up
人の魔物\n落命ヶ浜にて遭遇した\n\n古い時代、星宝寺の僧侶たちに\n四魂怪異:
Human Monster
Encountered at Rakumei Beach

In ancient times, the Four-Souls Anomaly
Appeared before the monks of Seihouji Temple
It was the discovery of a singular truth

Ten thousand eyes, a hundred snakes devouring a thousand corpses
Reaching oneness within ten wombs
山岳地帯で見られる大型の鼠\n攻撃的な性質は臆病さの裏返しで\nその様は、東国の:
A large rat found in mountainous regions
Its aggressive nature is merely a cover for cowardice
A trait that has even become a proverb in the eastern lands
自然に積み上げられた石ころ\n清廉潔白な魂が宿ると言われており\nそれを示すかの:
Naturally stacked pebbles
Said to harbor a pure and innocent soul
As if to prove it, it is weak to darkness
桜の花に似た体毛を持つ猛獣\n美しいため、油断して近づく者が多い\n\nサクラグ:
A ferocious beast with fur resembling cherry blossoms
Because of its beauty, many carelessly approach it

The Sakuraguma does not understand
Why the prey comes to it on its own
のんびりとした魔物\n冒険者でなくとも逃げることは容易く\n危険度は低い\n\n:
A carefree monster
Easy to escape even for non-adventurers
Its danger level is low

There is a being that leads the Namubeta
ナムベータを率いる存在\nそれとは完全な上下関係にある\n\n緩慢で、逃げること:
The entity that leads the Namubeta
Standing in absolute hierarchy above them

Sluggish as it is, escaping should be easy
Yet endless people choose not to
It is slimy and feels pleasant to touch
東国では最もありふれた害獣\n悪しき怪異といえば、これが連想される\n\n決して:
The most common vermin in the eastern lands
When speaking of evil anomalies, this comes to mind

An enemy with whom mutual understanding is impossible
One should cast aside all mercy
東国ではオドロに次いでありふれた害獣\n悪しき怪異といえば、これも連想される\n:
The most common vermin in the eastern lands after Odoro
When speaking of evil anomalies, this also comes to mind

While one's eyes may be drawn to its harmless-looking face-like part,
one must not overlook its massive claws
大柄な兎の怪異\n好奇心旺盛で、時には人にも懐く\n\n悪戯好きとして知られる\:
A large rabbit anomaly
Full of curiosity, it sometimes even warms up to people

Known to be mischievous
It likely just wants attention
八衢榕の厭い根: Loathsome Roots of the Yachimata Banyan
石拾い道にて遭遇した\n\n憐れにも魂を喰われた柴組の隊士\n根が絡み、もはや人:
Encountered at Stone-Gathering Path

A pitiful Shibagumi officer whose soul was devoured
With roots entangling him, he is no longer human

The loathsome roots sprout using victims as seedbeds
Even if it were your family or master,
you must decisively sever their head
秋水京にて遭遇した\n\n古くは都を騒がせた人斬りの霊\n今や廃れた白刀流の裏を:
Encountered at Shuisuikyo

The spirit of a manslayer who once terrorized the capital
Master of the secret techniques of the now-obsolete Hakutou Style

A blind swordsman struck down his driven-mad comrade
Yet even then, the tragedy did not end
カンムイ小径にて遭遇した\n\n地底に蔓延る根を断つ鬼\nそれが邪悪だと知るや知:
Encountered at Kamui Alley

An ogre that severs the roots spreading underground
Whether he knows it is evil or not,
he simply finds tearing them apart fun

Thus, he ends up serving the good of the world
主に滝然山表参道に生息する: Mainly inhabits Mt. Takizen Front Approach
飛び跳ね、弾んで移動する魔物\n球状の身体は反発力が高く\n時には意思に反し、あ:
A monster that moves by hopping and bouncing
Its spherical body is highly elastic
and sometimes sends it off in unintended directions despite its will
山にいるウミボウ\nどこか矛盾を感じる存在だが\n蛸が浮かぶ時点で、既にそうなの:
An Umibou found in the mountains
A somewhat contradictory existence,
but then again, floating octopuses were already contradictory enough
風の化身と言うべき存在\nその性質は精霊に近い\n\n移動の際には姿を消す\n自:
An entity that could be called the embodiment of wind
Its nature is close to that of a spirit

It erases its presence when moving,
blending seamlessly with the natural wind
主に滝然山星宝寺に生息する: Mainly inhabits Mt. Takizen Seihouji Temple
長い身体と多数の足を持つ虫の類\n足の内のいくつかは腕として機能し\n道具を使う:
A type of insect with a long body and numerous legs
Some of its legs function as arms,
and it appears capable of using tools
鬼としては小さく非力な存在\nしかしそれは鬼の中での話であり\n人から見れば、充:
Small and weak by ogre standards
However, that is only relative to other ogres;
from a human perspective, it possesses formidable strength

It goes by a different name beyond the seas,
though recently this name was deemed correct
正体不明の塊\n柔らかな肉のように蠢くが\n触れると冷たく、そして硬い:
A blob of unknown identity
It wriggles like soft flesh,
yet feels cold and hard to the touch
カンムイの子\n滝然山星宝寺にて遭遇した\n\nカンムイは人との融和を願う怪異で:
Child of Kamui
Encountered at Mt. Takizen Seihouji Temple

Kamui are anomalies that desire harmony with humans,
and most of their kin followed suit

However, the impulses of the soul rejected even their will,
leaving some pitiably warped
魔法により形を成したマナそのもの: Mana itself given shape through magic
これが自然に生まれることは稀\n大抵の場合、魔法の使い手が傍にいる:
It is rare for this to occur naturally
In most cases, a magic user is nearby
夜魔は雄のマナを好む\n故に男性は特に注意しなくてはならない\n\n満たされぬ夜:
Succubi prefer male mana
Therefore, men must be particularly careful

An unsatisfied succubus is no different from a beast
Unless you are female, you should run away
夜魔の中でも上位の存在\n強大な魔力と魅了の力を持ち\nあらゆるものを虜にする\:
A high-ranking entity among succubi
Possessing vast magic and powers of charm,
it captivates all things

Its diminutive stature is a reflection of the power it holds
葉に覆われた奇妙な存在\n高速で飛び回り、同時に風を起こす\n\n飛翔の怪異、天:
A strange creature covered in leaves
It flies at high speeds while generating wind

Said to be related to Tengu, the flight anomalies,
though the only similarity is its long, protruding nose
海の外にまで様々な逸話が伝えられる: with various anecdotes passed down even beyond the seas
曰く、赤は勇敢である\n敵を見れば我先にと挑むという:
They say the red ones are brave,
charging forward to challenge any enemy they see
曰く、青は臆病である\n常に赤の陰に隠れるという:
They say the blue ones are cowardly,
always hiding in the shadow of the red ones
死後の霊、あるいは悪意ある魂\nそう言い伝えられている存在\n\n実際には浮かび:
An entity rumored to be a spirit of the dead
or a malicious soul

In truth, it is merely a cluster of floating dust;
as long as you leave it alone, it poses little harm
洞窟に現れる大型の甲殻類\nくるりと丸まり、転がって移動しながら\nその動きによ:
A large crustacean that appears in caves
It curls into a ball and rolls around to move,
accumulating electricity inside its body through motion
狭間塚原にて遭遇した\n\nかつての戦にて、多くの敵を葬った怪異\n鋭い冷気は血:
Encountered at Hazama Tsukahara

An anomaly that slaughtered many enemies in a past war
Its piercing cold is said to have engulfed even its own kin

Regretting even after death, lingering attachment remained
Those feelings reached Kamui,
awakening as a soul to await judgment
影の魔物のように黒い身体を持ち\nそうであるかのように振舞う\n\n実体の弱点を:
It has a body as black as a shadow monster
and behaves as if it were one

It hides the vulnerabilities of its physical form;
it is quite clever
骨が連なってできたような魔物は\n骨が多くある場所にしか存在し得ない\n多くは碌:
Monsters that resemble linked chains of bones
can only exist in places where bones abound
Most of which are likely no good places
ひらひらとなびく奇妙な魔物\n東国では、これの飛来は凶兆とされ\n目にした者を慌:
A strange monster fluttering about
In the eastern lands, its arrival is seen as an ill omen,
sending those who witness it into a panic
暗い場所に現れる火の怪異\n灯りとして頼りにされることもあるが\n通常、人に対し:
A fire anomaly that appears in dark places
Though sometimes relied upon as a light source,
it is usually not friendly toward humans
夜な夜な泣き声をあげるという石\n宿る魂の嘆きとして恐れられているが\n妖狸たち:
A stone said to cry night after night
Feared as the lamentation of an inhabiting soul,
yet the magical tanuki view it as a birth cry
and celebrate it as a good omen
小柄な屍は、決まって強い腕力を持つ\n姿に似合わず、異様なまでに\n\nどうして:
Small corpses invariably possess great physical strength
Unnatural as it may seem given their appearance

They desperate for attention;
in their desire to hold you back, they exert raw force
東ではあまねく知られる土着の怪異\n死に誘うものとして悪名高い\n\n沼の際、歩:
A local anomaly widely known throughout the east
Infamous as a harbinger that entices one to death

Do not walk along the edge of the swamp
Do not take the hand beckoning from the depths
狸の魔物\nぽんぽこ村にて遭遇した\n\n東の果て、不気味な村に現れる妖狸\n迷:
Tanuki Monster
Encountered at Ponpoko Village

A magical tanuki appearing in an eerie village at the eastern edge
It tricks lost children, sometimes driving them all the way back to the capital

There is no malice or hostility in its rough welcome
Only maternal concern, and a small touch of mischief
ありふれた害獣、オドロの類: A common vermin, a kin of Odoro
より強く、迷惑になっている: Stronger, and even more of a nuisance
分かり合える日など来ない\n慈悲は捨て置くべきだろう:
A day of mutual understanding will never come
One should cast aside all mercy
ありふれた害獣、ウダラの類: A common vermin, a kin of Udara
無害そうな顔も、もはや憎らしい\n早々に斬り捨てた方がよい:
Even its harmless-looking face is now hateful
It is best to strike it down without delay
蛾の魔物\n鐘突き洞にて遭遇した\n\n何者かの道具であることは喜びであり\nそ:
Moth Monster
Encountered at Bell-Tolling Cave

Being someone's tool was a joy,
and through this, it continually sought to confirm its worth

Yet the time when it would decay and be discarded was bound to come
Terrified by that alone,
the garment began to weave life itself
何にも憑かず、よじれ浮かぶ厭い根\nよりよい骸の方へと進む\n\nこれに意思など:
A loathsome root twisting and floating without possessing anything
It moves toward a superior corpse

It possesses no will
You have no choice but to slash it, unless you wish for death
榕絡みが討たれぬままでいると\n徘徊する苗床となり、各地に種を増やす\n\nやが:
If the Banyan-Entangled remains unslain,
it becomes a wandering seedbed, scattering seeds across the land

Eventually growing to uncontrollable numbers
That was how that war began
精霊の一種であるとも言われ\n出会った者に、ささやかな恵みをもたらすという:
Said to be a type of spirit,
it is believed to bestow modest blessings upon those it encounters
光を帯びた神秘の狐\n獣の姿をしているが、曖昧であり\n実態は幽霊に近い:
A mystical fox shrouded in light
Though taking the form of a beast, it is vague,
and its actual essence is closer to a ghost
主にかつての眠りの森に生息する\n\nコンパクに混じり、時折見かける人型の狐\n:
Mainly inhabits Former Forest of Slumber

A humanoid fox occasionally seen among Konpaku
Though ghost-like, it possesses a physical body

Disliking conflict, it will not initiate an attack
Unless it senses danger to itself
西の僻地の襤褸神社にて、ただ独り\n何かを待つかのように巫女は佇む\n\n剣の神:
Alone in a tattered shrine in the western remote lands,
the shrine maiden stands as if awaiting something

The God of the Sword will surely return
and vanquish that evil

Precisely because of this wish, she tests your power with her whole soul
大怪異は、狭間塚原の乱の果て\n討つべき諸悪に刃を振るった\n\nそれは届かず、:
At the end of the Hazama Tsukahara Rebellion,
the Great Anomaly swung its blade against the evil that had to be vanquished

It fell short and shattered to pieces
Even so, its dying wish was carried on
岩屋の蓋にて遭遇した: Encountered at Cover of the Rock Cave
捻じ曲がっている厭い根の雑兵\n骸を求め、あらゆる生物に憑りつき\nその魂を貪る:
A twisted foot soldier of the loathsome root
Seeking corpses, it possesses all living creatures
and devours their souls
厭い根の目的は魂を喰うことではないが\nそうして力を増し、姿かたちを変えて\nよ:
Although devouring souls is not the loathsome roots' purpose,
by doing so they swell with power, altering their form
to create corpses all the more efficiently.
根源より伸びる主根はすべてが本体であり\n一つでも残せば、他に力を分けて\nたち:
Every taproot extending from the source is the main body itself.
Leave even a single one intact, and it shares its power with the rest,
instantly restoring all eight.

Slayer them simultaneously, and at last it reveals itself—
the ancient root of calamity, the chronic affliction of Shikinowa.
古の禍根、八衢榕: Ancient Root of Calamity, Yachimata Banyan
猛攻により姿を露わにした邪悪\n落とされた主根は再生しつつあり\nそれぞれがまる:
An evil exposed by fierce assault.
The severed taproots are in the midst of regenerating,
each taking on the appearance of a head.

Long ago, when eight serpents unsealed the rock cavern,
the fulfilled wish churned existence itself.

And thus was born the serpent with eight heads.
これが自然に生まれることは稀だが\nあり得ないわけではない:
While it rarely manifests naturally,
it is not entirely impossible.
寒冷地にいる奇妙な鳥\n飛べない代わりに泳ぎが得意\n\n普段はのろまな様子だが:
A peculiar bird found in frigid lands.
Unable to fly, it excels at swimming instead.

Though usually slow-moving,
when hunting it glides across ice at high speeds.
白い体毛を持つ猛獣\n雪に紛れ、獲物へと忍び寄る\n\nウェングマは強いが油断は:
A ferocious beast with white fur.
It blends into the snow to stalk its prey.

Though mighty, the Wenguma is never careless;
it is both clever and cautious.
雪原を遊び場とする黒い兎\nその色は、とても目立つ\n\n強さゆえに隠れないので:
A black rabbit that treats the snowfields as its playground.
Its coat makes it stand out immensely.

It does not hide, not out of strength,
but in hopes that a playmate might spot it.
雪女の魔物\n迷い森の深部にて遭遇した\n\nウパシモシリの森の深くに住む魔物\:
Yuki-onna Monster
Encountered deep within the Lost Forest

A monster dwelling deep within the forest of Upashimosir.
It temporarily aids those who have lost their way and grown weak.

Yet that is a path to ruin.
At times they become decorated ice statues;
at times, forced into wedlock.
この魔物が単独で行動することはなく\n同種の、より優れた存在を守るように取り巻く:
This monster never acts alone,
flocking around superior kin of its kind as if to protect them.

They are all good friends.
この魔物にとって取り巻きは盾に過ぎず\n使い捨てで、替えがきく存在だろう\n\n:
To this monster, its entourage is nothing more than a shield—
disposable and easily replaced.

Even so, they are all good friends.
コタンの蔵にて遭遇した\n\n罠としてよく知られている魔物\n不意に開けられてし:
Encountered in the Kotan Storehouse

A monster well known as a trap.
Because it was opened unawares,
it reflexively beats the offender to death.

There seems to have been a misunderstanding;
this child bears little ill will.
東国の僻地に住むという小人\n星の光に共鳴し、その力を行使する\n\n友好的な者:
A dwarf said to reside in the remote reaches of the eastern lands.
It resonates with starlight to wield its power.

While quite a few are friendly,
most are timid and keep out of sight.
精霊に近い存在で、生息地に漂うマナが\nその地の属性を含み出現した魔物\n\nこ:
A creature akin to a spirit, spawned when mana drifting
in its habitat absorbs the local element.

This one harbors the Ice element.
強大な魔力を持つ魔物\n蛸の触手と犬の耳が特徴\n\nまともに戦えば苦戦は必至\:
A monster possessing immense magic power,
characterized by octopus tentacles and dog ears.

Taking it head-on guarantees a hard fight;
it is best to strike with the Lightning element.
カンムイ・チャシにて遭遇した\n\nかつて血族が積み上げた宝殿の門番\n這わぬも:
Encountered in Kamui Chashi

A gatekeeper of the treasury built by kin of old,
it continually eliminated non-crawling beings.

Ironically, its limbs have now crumbled away,
leaving it with a shape resembling a serpent.
巨大な鉈を振るう小鬼\nその膂力は尋常ならざるものであり\n敵の胴を、骨ごと断つ:
A small ogre wielding a massive hatchet.
Its physical strength is extraordinary,
cleaving an enemy's torso cleanly through the bone.
悪意をなびかせる風の化身\n近づくものすべてを切り裂く\n\n刃は無差別に、仲間:
An incarnation of wind fluttering with malice,
slicing apart anything that draws near.

Its blades are indiscriminate, turning even against allies;
thus, it gets along poorly with other races.
妖狸によく似た怪異の類\n敵を化かし、そして命を奪う遊びをする\n\n決して混同:
A species of anomaly closely resembling a magical tanuki.
It tricks its foes, making a game out of taking their lives.

Make no mistake—
the Mujina is no magical tanuki, and finds the comparison quite offensive.
かの山は日が初めに昇る地であり\n太平の黎明の標として、信仰の対象となる\n\n:
That mountain is where the sun first rises,
worshipped as a symbol of the dawn of peace.

At its summit resides an ogre,
enjoying the sunrise from a front-row seat.
鬼面で顔を覆った柴組の隊士\nそうして表情を隠し、迷いを悟らせない\nあるいは、:
A Shibagumi soldier whose face is concealed by an ogre mask.
In doing so, she hides her expression so her hesitations remain unknown—
perhaps even to herself.
その志だけが、彼女を動かしていた: Only her resolve drove her forward.
水底にいるウミボウ\n魂と共に、魂のように漂う\n\n特に変わったところはない\:
An Umibou residing on the water's floor,
drifting alongside souls, like a soul itself.

There is nothing particularly unusual about it;
one might call it an Umi-Umibou, so to speak.
来世に住むと言われる魔物\n稀に境界を抜け、現世に姿を見せる\n\n燐火は黄泉路:
A monster said to dwell in the next life.
On rare occasions, it crosses the boundary to appear in the present world.

Will-o'-the-wisps drift in the evening beyond the Yomi path.
闇の中に佇む謎めいた肉塊\n顔はないが、表情を作るかのように\n不気味に歪むこと:
A mysterious lump of flesh standing still in the dark.
It has no face, yet it sometimes contorts eerily
as if attempting to form an expression.
巡り黄泉路にて遭遇した\n\n海の底、魂流るるレーセ川\nそれは廃都ウェン・マー:
Encountered at Winding Yomi Path

At the sea floor flows the Rese River, carrying souls.
Located in the underworld of the ruined capital Wen Mar Sas,
it is one of the pardons meant to leave no lingering stagnation.

The horse accompanying the guide resembles a nightmare,
but it is not; rather, it is a kin of the Grim Reaper.
その存在を渇望され蘇った名将\n朽ちかけた肉体に魂を宿した\n\n全盛期には遠く:
A renowned general resurrected out of desperate longing for his existence,
housing a soul within a decaying body.

Far from his prime,
yet all hopes—both his own and others'—
rouse his still-faltering soul.
継承した力を解放した無玄\n稲妻を呼び、龍の威光を轟かせる\n\n民が望む永劫の:
Mugen, having unleashed his inherited power,
summons lightning and thunders with the majesty of the dragon.

Believing in the eternal peace desired by the people
and the hopes placed upon him, he swings his blade;
yet he could never bring himself to trust the self
that compromised its own will to achieve it.
主に龍の宮に生息する: Mainly inhabits Palace of the Dragon
害獣オドロの古きもの: An ancient variant of the vermin Odoro
善悪とは、そう簡単に論じられないが: Good and evil cannot be debated so easily, but...
害獣ウダラの古きもの: An ancient variant of the vermin Udara
奈落より現れる火の怪異\nそれは咎人、穢れた魂を炙る炎であり\n終わりなき責め苦:
A fire anomaly emerging from the abyss.
It is a flame that scorches sinners and defiled souls,
serving as one of the endless torments.
鶏に似たからくりの類\n魂もなしに、なぜか動き出す:
A type of automaton resembling a rooster.
Without so much as a soul, it somehow begins to move.
あるいは罠かもしれない: Or perhaps it is a trap.
龍の宮にて遭遇した\n\n血族なき宮殿にある厭い根らしきもの\n種を増やそうとす:
Encountered at Palace of the Dragon

A creature resembling a loathsome root found in a kinless palace.
It shows no sign of attempting to spread its seeds.

Even after the serpents' betrayal, it swore peaceful coexistence;
yet the emergence of the Banyan distorted its very existence.
精霊の一種であると言われるが\nそう説明できる根拠はない:
It is said to be a type of spirit,
though there is no basis to confirm such a claim.
シキノワの大怪異\n全景域にて遭遇した\n\n次なる龍の到達を待つ魂\nカンムイ:
Great Anomaly of Shikinowa
Encountered across All Regions

A soul awaiting the arrival of the next dragon,
biding its time until the day it becomes a Kamui.

Coexistence with other species, or dominion over them—
none can say which is truly right.
Perhaps that is precisely why a Kamui is born.
様々な怪談にて語られる怪異\nそのいずれもが死に関わるもので\n相対すれば、それ:
An anomaly spoken of in various ghost stories.
Every single one of them pertains to death,
and facing it head-on proves those tales true.
闇に朽ちた石の寄せ集め\nかつては光をたたえていたが\n今や知るべくもない:
A cluster of stones decayed in the dark.
Though it once brimmed with light,
one can no longer tell.
穢れた地にて見かける霊狐\n訪れた者を、じっと見つめる\n\n何もしないのは敵意:
A spirit fox seen in defiled lands,
gazing intently at visitors.

Its inaction is not from a lack of hostility;
it simply pities them.
遥か空の上、闇より落ちた謎の存在\n星の死と共に滲み出すというが\nその正体は誰:
A mysterious entity fallen from the dark high above the sky.
It is said to ooze forth alongside the death of a star,
yet its true identity remains unknown to all.
奈落にある龍の偶像\nこれもまた、セセクの民の作であり\n足袋蛇たちへの贈り物で:
A dragon idol located in the abyss.
This, too, was made by the Seseku people
as a gift for the Tabi Serpents.

Though it decayed deep beneath the earth after the betrayal,
it pulls strings to protect the abandoned village.
かつて命への贖罪の果てに谷を下り\nそこで真の禍根を見た僧侶\n\n敵に対し、あ:
A monk who once descended into the valley in atonement for lives lost,
only to behold the true root of calamity.

He was utterly powerless against the enemy.
Though defiled, he spent what little life he had solely on sealing it,
simply awaiting the arrival of a hero.

As endless time passed,
even his sanity was lost.
奈落の底の、とある村にいるもの\n淵に隠れ、何かを呟き続け\n己を見つけた者を斬:
A presence in a certain village at the bottom of the abyss.
It hides in the depths, constantly muttering something,
and strikes down anyone who finds it.

It has long lost its personality,
and perhaps even its life has expired.
Only hatred, sorrow, and remorse
refuse to permit the death of its soul.
カンムイより分かたれた魂の一つ: One of the souls split from the Kamui
城ほどもある大鬼として語られ\n百王柴鬼の名を馳せる\n\n巨躯の正体はからくり:
Spoken of as a massive ogre as large as a castle,
bearing the name of the Hundred-King Shiba-Oni.

The true nature of its colossal frame is an automaton armament;
its hobby simply escalated out of hand.
夜伽鬼を束ねる妖狐として語られ\n五尾夕闇の名を馳せる\n\n現代にて、最も知ら:
Spoken of as the phantom fox commanding the night-guarding ogres,
she made a name for herself as the Five-Tailed Yugao.

In modern times, she is the most well-known child of the Kamui,
running a shop in the capital and enjoying the world of mortals.
化け狸の長、夜行の先導として語られ\n妖狸隠神の名を馳せる\n\n東の里では守り:
Spoken of as the chief of bake-danuki and guide of the night procession,
he made a name for himself as the phantom tanuki Inugami.

In the eastern village he is revered as a guardian deity,
while also serving as a lifelong friend.
主に鵺の胎道に生息する\n\n魂を漂うマナの残滓\n自律し、魔法を放つこともある:
Mainly inhabits Birth Canal of the Nue

Residue of mana drifting through souls.
It acts autonomously and sometimes casts magic.

Perhaps it is a remnant of memory.
鼠の魔物\n主に笹倉霊園に生息する\n\nロームンの亜種。とても凶暴\n戦いでは:
Rat Monster
Mainly inhabits Sasakura Cemetery

A subspecies of the Roamun. Extremely ferocious.
While it can only scratch in battle,
its movements are swift and free of wasted motion.
かつて亜命が残したもの: Left behind by A-mikoto in ages past
これは、頭である\n\n旧鬼面隊、初代柴組隊長\n穂武良行春により討たれた:
This is the head.

Slain by Homura Yukiharu,
the first captain of the Shibagumi in the former Onimen-tai.
闇に溶ける漆黒の羽毛を持つ\n真夜中ではまともに視認できないが\n幸いなことに、:
Possesses jet-black plumage that melts into darkness.
At midnight it cannot be properly seen,
but fortunately, it sleeps through the night.
東方の島国シキノワの忍者\n覆ったものを透明にする羽毛を持ち\n自身だけでなく、:
A ninja from the eastern island nation of Shikinowa.
It possesses feathers that turn whatever they cover transparent,
concealing not only itself, but its prey as well.
これは、尾である\n\n鎖影衆頭目\n大天狗により討たれた:
This is the tail.

Slain by Great Tengu,
leader of the Saeishu.
主にユニ・サーキットに生息する\n\n全知の海に漂う箱\n記録媒体であり、権限を:
Mainly inhabits Uni-Circuit

A box drifting in the sea of omniscience.
It acts as a recording medium, said to grant knowledge
to those who possess authorization.
これは、四肢である\n\n何者かに討たれたはずだが\nそれが誰かは分からない:
These are the limbs.

It should have been slain by someone,
yet who that was remains unknown.
天上からの伝令\n主にガラスの町に生息する\n\n世界の様子を見守る存在\n天使:
Messenger from Heaven
Mainly inhabits Glass Town

A existence watching over the state of the world.
They belong to a race called angels, not monsters.

They reside in the heavenly town,
and normally never descend to the surface.
これは、胴である\n\n虚の時代の観測者\n銀の天使ケセファルにより討たれた:
This is the torso.

Slain by Kesephal, the Silver Angel
and observer of the Void Era.
鵺の胎道にて遭遇した: Encountered at Birth Canal of the Nue
正体不明であることだけが語られ\nその名すら、誰も知らない\n\nただ独り、旅を:
Spoken of only as an unknown identity;
not even its true name is known to anyone.

It journeyed entirely alone—
a journey far, far too long.
長く鋭い角を持つ大型の獣\nその角に貫けぬものはないと言われる\n\n決して過言:
A large beast bearing a long, sharp horn.
It is said there is nothing its horn cannot pierce.

This is by no means an exaggeration;
do not attempt to block its charge with armor or a shield.
砂漠にいる犬の魔物\n彷徨う旅人を導くように動くが\n本人も、あまりよく分かって:
A canine monster found in the desert.
It acts as if guiding lost travelers,
though it does not really know where it is going either,
making it dangerous to follow.

It harbors no intent to deceive;
it genuinely believes it is doing a good deed.
赤褐色のサボテン\n植物ではなく、砂嵐に紛れながら\n密やかに死の魔法を唱える:
A reddish-brown cactus.
It is no mere plant; blending into sandstorms,
it stealthily chants magic of death.
アルワーフ砂漠にて遭遇した\n\n砂漠に隠された秘宝\nそれを追う者が、最後に目:
Encountered in Al Waha Desert

The secret treasure hidden within the desert;
the final sight beheld by those who pursue it.

That treasure is you, who reached this place.
Now, let us await the next treasure together.
主に門のブルジュに生息する: Mainly inhabits Burj of the Gate
生息地を規則的に飛び回る\n\n外側に伸びる刃が仕込まれており\n思いの外、原始:
It flies systematically around its habitat.

Fitted with blades extending outward,
it attacks in a surprisingly primitive fashion.
魂を動力とする機械人形\nただじっと何かを待つように佇み\n危険な存在を発見する:
A mechanical doll powered by souls.
It stands motionless as if waiting for something,
commencing elimination upon detecting a threat.
門のブルジュにて遭遇した: Encountered at Burj of the Gate
ブルジュにて待ち受ける封印者の一人: One of the sealers lying in wait at the Burj
太陽を覆う闇を守るもの: Protector of the darkness shrouding the sun
現代では、唯一の旧型\nとても頑丈だったのだ:
In modern times, it is the sole old model remaining;
it was extraordinarily durable.
聖刻遺跡にて遭遇した\n\n勇士を偽る者を罰する存在\n光の属性を蓄え、それを放:
Encountered at Sacred Inscription Ruins

An entity that punishes those who impersonate brave warriors.
It stores Light-elemental energy and unleashes it.

There is no past precedent of its appearance;
for deceiving the gods is impossible to begin with.
蛮族と呼ばれる魔物の一種\n手先が器用で腕力も知能も優れる\n才能を生かし、物作:
A type of monster referred to as a barbarian.
Deft with its hands, possessing superior strength and intelligence.
Many apply their talents toward crafting and manufacturing.

It has a strong libido.
縦に長いサボテン\nじっと動かず、無害なふりをするが\nその大きさこそが威圧的だ:
A tall, elongated cactus.
It remains motionless, pretending to be harmless,
yet its sheer scale is intimidating.
少女のようなサボテン\n普段は植物のようにじっとしているが\n時折、陽気に踊り始:
A girl-like cactus.
Usually standing still like a plant,
it occasionally breaks into a cheerful dance.
砂漠に潜む刺客\nマイヤの都市遺跡にて遭遇した\n\n虚無派と呼ばれる砂漠の民\:
An assassin lurking in the desert.
Encountered at the Maya City Ruins.

Desert folk known as the Nihilists.
Devoid of humanity, they have degenerated into monsters.

While they too praise the gods,
they cannot tolerate those who do so differently.
主に輝きの大ブルジュに生息する: Mainly inhabits Great Burj of Radiance
瓦礫の魔物とされているが\n実際は、影に似た黒い染みのような存在\n身を隠すため:
Though classified as a rubble monster,
it is actually a entity resembling a black shadow-stain.
It is said to drape itself in debris to hide,
yet this only makes it stand out more.
長い包帯に巻かれた屍\n生を感じると棺より目覚め\n死を与えようとする\n\nこ:
A corpse wrapped in long bandages.
Sensing life, it awakens from its coffin to bestow death.

Despite its appearance, it is lonely;
it simply wants you to die together with it.
輝きの大ブルジュにて遭遇した: Encountered at Great Burj of Radiance
猛禽頭は、太陽の子\nかつては輝きを守っていた:
The raptor-headed one is a child of the sun,
who once guarded the radiance.
開閉できる甲殻を持つ\nその内側は広く、小柄な者ならば乗り込めるほど\n\n残念:
Possesses a shell that can open and close.
Its interior is spacious enough for a small person to climb inside.

Unfortunately, it is not a comfortable space,
as it is stocked with poison-soaked food.
冠羽に鈍器を括り付けた奇妙な鳥\nそれを振り回し敵を撃滅する\n\n人に対し、異:
A strange bird with a blunt weapon bound to its crest.
It swings the weapon around to obliterate foes.

Unusually aggressive toward humans;
perhaps it harbors a grudge.
蚊の魔物\nアフダル高地にて遭遇した\n\n特別な装置で寄る辺なきルーフを集め\:
Mosquito Monster
Encountered in the Ahdal Highlands

A hard worker that uses a special apparatus
to gather stray Ruh and convey them to a managed facility.

It does not appear to suck blood;
calling it a mosquito makes it extremely sour-tempered.
亡骸を苗床に育つ忌まわしい花\n死を象徴する不吉な存在として厭われるが\n実際は:
An abhorrent flower that grows using corpses as a bed.
Though loathed as an ill omen symbolizing death,
in truth, it is a symbol of rebirth sprouting from death.
高度な魔力と知能を持つ魔物\nそのいずれも、人の身では理解できない\n\n極めて:
A monster possessing advanced magic and high intelligence,
neither of which mortal minds can comprehend.

An extremely rare, naturally born magical creature
that has been the subject of various studies,
yet none have yielded meaningful results.
猛獣頭は、ルーフの織り手\nかつては生命を守っていた:
The beast-headed one is a weaver of Ruh,
who once guarded life itself.
乾燥地帯を徘徊する獣\n死肉を漁り、骨までも砕き\nその破片を武器にする:
A beast roaming arid lands.
It scavenges carrion, crushing even bones
to fashion their splinters into weapons.
猛毒を持つ巨大な蛇\n液体としてそれを浴びせかけ\n魔法で追い打ちをかける\n\:
A giant snake bearing deadly venom.
It douses prey in liquid poison,
then follows up with magical attacks.

Its sinister warning colors are a mercy in its own way.
雷を浴び、活性化した屍\nそれなりの知能と強大な魔力を持つ\n\nグーラは人の肉:
A corpse revitalized by a strike of lightning,
possessing decent intelligence and formidable magic.

Ghoula feeds on human flesh;
to her, adventurers are merely food.
人型の魔物\n眠る砂漠にて遭遇した\n\nマナを求めて砂漠を彷徨う正体不明の存在:
A humanoid monster.
Encountered in the Sleeping Desert.

An unidentified entity wandering the desert in pursuit of mana.

Eerily quiet and sluggish,
yet upon discovering prey while starved,
its violent nature is laid bare.
蠅の魔物の幼虫\n死肉が豊富な場所に現れ、繁殖する\n\n密集して活動し、一つの:
The larva of a fly monster.
It appears and breeds in places rich with dead flesh.

Moving in dense swarms to crowd a single piece of meat;
many an adventurer looks upon the sight with revulsion.
蛆の魔物の成虫\n高い魔力を蓄え、風の魔法を放つ\n\n蠅は幼虫のために腐肉を集:
The adult form of the maggot monster.
It stores high magic power to unleash Wind spells.

The fly gathers carrion to build pillars for its larvae;
a noble behavior necessary for child-rearing,
yet bizarre to outside eyes.
狼頭は、永遠の眠りの番人\nかつては死者の安寧を守っていた:
The wolf-headed one is the keeper of eternal slumber,
who once guarded the peace of the deceased.
主に地上の星空に生息する: Mainly inhabits Starry Sky on the Surface
古い時代を生きた精霊の類: A species of spirit from an ancient era
レタルと呼ばれた真白の国では\n真白の大樹が佇んでいた:
In the pure-white land known as Retar,
a pure-white giant tree stood tall.
東国の霊狐の祖先: Ancestor of the Eastern Spirit Foxes
レタルと呼ばれた真白の国には\n魂を見通す民がいた:
In the pure-white land known as Retar,
there dwelt a people who could see through souls.
レタルと呼ばれた真白の国\n四季の和は、そこにあった:
The pure-white land known as Retar;
there lay the harmony of the four seasons.
主にシャマル・ハラムに生息する\n\n守衛として利用される機械\n何かを守るため:
Mainly inhabits Shamal Haram.

A machine utilized as a guard.
It exists to protect something,
and should it lose its charge, it seeks out a new target on its own.
アスワドの神の敵\nシャマル・ハラムにて遭遇した\n\n勇士の旅の果てにあるもの:
Enemy of the God of Aswad
Encountered in Shamal Haram

That which lies at the end of a brave warrior's journey;
yet something distinct from it.

Once, an enemy truly resided there,
but now only an echo like this resounds.
とても古い機械生命体\nその昔、警備用に役立てられた\n\nまるで子犬のようだが:
An ancient mechanical lifeform
used long ago for security.

Resembles a puppy,
though one should not dream of taming it.
とても古い大型の機械生命体\nその昔、警備用に大いに役立てられた\n\n言うまで:
An ancient, large-scale mechanical lifeform
greatly utilized long ago for security.

Needless to say,
do not dream of taming it.
人類の宿敵\n説明は不要だろう:
The archenemy of mankind;
no explanation is needed.
アル・ヘルムの街にいる犬の魔物\n極彩色の光に翻弄されながらも\n好き勝手に駆け:
A dog monster in the city of Al Helm.
While toyed with by gaudy, vibrant lights,
it runs wild, makes noise, plays as it pleases,
and pisses wherever it wants.
罠の魔物として知られる存在の中身\n宝箱を失い、自らの足で当てもなく彷徨う\n\:
The inner form of an entity known as a trap monster.
Having lost its treasure chest, it wanders aimlessly on its own feet.

It will not become hostile unless provoked,
but should that happen, it will pursue you relentlessly.
Escape is difficult; you have no choice but to defeat it.
虫の魔物\nイブティサーマにて遭遇した\n\n宿敵は、いつの時代にも存在し\nい:
Insect Monster
Encountered in Ibtisama

An archenemy exists in every era,
and remains an archenemy no matter the age.

Or perhaps it could be called an archetype of lore.
滞空しながら索敵し、周囲を監視する\n\n回転しながらの突撃は極めて鋭く\n人の:
It hovers while searching for targets, monitoring its surroundings.

Its spinning charge is extremely sharp,
enough to sever human limbs.
動力を失っているオルーサ\nなおも動く原因はよく分からないが\nとかく魔物とは、:
An Orusa that has lost its power source.
The reason it still moves is unclear,
but that is simply how monsters come into being.
オルーサ製造所にて遭遇した\n\nアル・ヘルムでは最大のオルーサ\n労働や防衛の:
Encountered at Orusa Manufactory

The largest Orusa in Al Helm.
Created not for labor or defense,
but with a special purpose in mind.

It requires a vast amount of Ruh to operate,
exerting a severe influence on its surroundings during creation.
主に第三層研究施設に生息する: Mainly inhabits Third Layer Research Facility
まるでコタマに見える魔物\n実態は、なにか迷惑な存在であり\n勝って得られるもの:
A monster that looks remarkably like a Kotama.
In reality, it is merely a nuisance,
and defeating it yields very little reward.
真白の国で暮らしていた兎の怪異\n何か動くものを見つけたら\nひとまずついていく:
A rabbit apparition that lived in the pure-white land.
Upon spotting anything moving,
it has a habit of following it along for the time being.

It is quiet at night;
it is far too busy gazing at the moon.
魂を操るというキマイラ\nそうして概念的な繋がりを築き\n全なる知識を一にする\:
A chimera said to manipulate souls,
thereby forging conceptual connections
to unify all knowledge into one.

In Retar, it was revered as a godlike entity,
and its divine techniques served as a foundation.
定められた場所を守る機械\n不審者を発見すると追跡を初め\n搭載した兵器により破:
A machine that guards a designated location.
Upon detecting an intruder, it initiates pursuit
and attempts destruction using its onboard weaponry.
猫のような姿をした影の魔物\n逃走するということが最大の特徴で\n仕留めるのは、:
A shadow monster possessing a feline form.
Its defining trait is its tendency to flee,
making it quite difficult to finish off.

Frequently seen during the age of myth;
perhaps it has simply grown fed up with the present.
竜は比類なき種族として知られるが\n竜人もまたそうである\n\nそして、時には凌:
Dragons are known as an peerless race,
and dragonkin are no different.

And yet, on occasion, there are those who surpass even them.
アル・ヘルムを守る機械人形: A mechanical doll protecting Al Helm
ルーフの遺志により今なお動き続け\n滅びの尖兵を排除する:
It continues to function driven by the lingering will of Ruh,
eliminating vanguard forces of destruction.
彼らは誤認しているわけではなく\n故障しているわけでもない\n\nただ、悟ってし:
They are not misinterpreting,
nor are they malfunctioning.

They have simply attained enlightenment.
アスワドの民の魂\n中枢管理塔にて遭遇した\n\nその思いはただ一つ、神の伝承\:
The souls of the people of Aswad.
Encountered at the Central Control Tower.

They harbor but a single thought: the lore of the gods.

They praised the sun and martyred themselves for the future,
yet now they weep in terror of loss.

That they bear traces of former brave warriors
is likely because they were once symbols of the people's hope.
味方単体のHPを50％回復するゼリー状の薬。: A jelly medicine that restores 50% HP to a single ally.
世界的な組織、アウラム商会が作るもの: Produced by the global organization known as Aurum Trading Company.
回復薬としては、今や定番である\n冒険者の必需品と言えるだろう:
As a recovery item, it has become a standard staple;
one could say it is an absolute necessity for adventurers.
味方単体のHPを100％回復するゼリー状の薬。: A jelly-like medicine that restores 100% HP to a single ally.
回復薬として、とても大きな効果を持つ: It possesses an immense effect as a recovery medicine.
同時に価格もとても大きい: Concurrently, its price tag is equally immense.
味方単体のSPを50％回復するゼリー状の薬。: A jelly-like medicine that restores 50% SP to a single ally.
技や魔法を放つには、相応の気力が必要になる\nこれはその助けとなるだろうが\n材:
Unleashing skills and magic requires a corresponding degree of spirit.
While this serves to aid that process,
it fetches a high price due to the vast amount of mana used as material.
味方単体のSPを100％回復するゼリー状の薬。: A jelly-like medicine that restores 100% SP to a single ally.
味方単体の状態異常を解除するゼリー状の薬。: A jelly-like medicine that cures status ailments for a single ally.
赤枠の状態異常は解除できない。: Red-framed status ailments cannot be cured.
身体の異常を治療する薬品: A medicine that treats bodily afflictions.
これは、状態異常のみを治す\n外傷が癒えることはなく、体勢を立て直す力もない:
This cures status ailments alone;
it does not heal external injuries, nor does it possess the power to regain one's footing.
味方単体の能力値DOWNを解除するゼリー状の薬。: A jelly-like medicine that cures stat decreases for a single ally.
これは、能力値の低下のみを治す\n外傷が癒えることはなく、体勢を立て直す力もない:
This cures stat decreases alone;
it does not heal external injuries, nor does it possess the power to regain one's footing.
味方単体を復活させHPを25％回復するマナを宿した液体。: A mana-infused liquid that revives a single ally and restores 25% HP.
戦闘不能となった者を回復させる液体: A liquid that recovers someone who has been rendered incapacitated.
戦闘不能状態と死亡は全く異なる: Incapacitated status and death are entirely different.
前者は、その名の通り戦闘を続けられない状態を指す: The former, true to its name, refers to a state where one can no longer continue fighting.
味方単体を復活させHPを100％回復するマナを宿した液体。: A mana-infused liquid that revives a single ally and restores 100% HP.
後者を覆す薬品は存在しない: No medicine exists that can reverse the latter.
味方単体のHPとSPを100％回復する薬。: A medicine that restores 100% HP and SP to a single ally.
一流の錬金術師が作り出す特別な薬品: A special medicine produced by top-tier alchemists.
早々手に入るものではない: It is not something easily obtained.
ここぞというときに使うべきだろう: It should be saved for crucial moments.
味方全体のHPとSPを100％回復する薬。: A medicine that restores 100% HP and SP to all allies.
ここぞというときですら、使用を惜しむ: A elixir so rare that one hesitates to use it, even in crucial moments.
味方単体のレベルを1上昇させる不思議な種。: A mysterious seed that increases a single ally's level by 1.
驚異の成長力を秘めたもの\nこれはマナの形態の一つであり\nその見た目から種と呼:
Imbued with phenomenal growth potential,
this is one manifestation of mana,
referred to as a seed due to its appearance.

The power to foster growth is the very essence of mana;
a world lacking it is fated to fall into ruin.
味方単体のすべての能力値を5上昇させる果実。: A fruit that increases all stats of a single ally by 5.
食べると身体の基礎能力が向上する\n \nこれはマナの果実である\n口にすれば、:
Consuming it enhances the body's fundamental capabilities.

This is a fruit of mana;
upon taking a bite, one's strength as a living creature increases.

It tastes absolutely foul.
敵単体に約500の波動属性魔法ダメージを与える爆弾。: A bomb that deals approximately 500 Wave-elemental magic damage to a single enemy.
波動の魔法を封じ込めた爆弾\n \n波動属性は、マナそのものの力である\n故に、:
A bomb sealing wave magic within.

The Wave element is the force of mana itself;
thus, it is effective against most foes,
though it cannot bypass magic resistance.
敵全体の強化効果を打ち消す爆弾。\n赤枠の強化効果は解除できない。:
A bomb that dispels buff effects on all enemies.
Red-framed buffs cannot be dispelled.
愛する者に捧げる指輪。: A ring dedicated to one's beloved.
誰かに贈るためのもの: An item meant to be gifted to someone.
これは、永遠の愛を誓う\n \nただ一人と、悠久の契りを:
This pledges eternal love;
an everlasting covenant with a single soul.
花を紙に押して作られた飾り。: An ornament made by pressing flowers onto paper.
狐を模した木彫りの人形。: A wooden doll carved in the likeness of a fox.
創作意欲を刺激する玩具。: A toy that stimulates creative inspiration.
都の名店、とらやの土産物。: A souvenir from Toraya, a famous store in the capital.
神をも酔わせ化かすという酒。: Sake said to intoxicate and beguile even the gods.
冒険者ギルドが発行する読み物。: Reading material published by the Adventurers Guild.
冒険者ギルドが発行する紙面\n \n冒険者が持つ情報は一つの組織に集積され\nそ:
A publication issued by the Adventurers Guild.

Information held by adventurers is collected into a single organization
and disseminated, helping people acquire common knowledge.
北方の大国の作家の作品。: A work by an author from a great northern nation.
暗い雰囲気の絵本\n \n青で構成された絵は読み手を不安にさせるが\nそれは、最:
A picture book with a dark atmosphere.

The illustrations rendered in shades of blue unease the reader,
yet they serve to color the final thread of hope.
これは、糞である\n \n贈り物としては常軌を逸している:
This is, plain and simple, dung.

As a gift, it is beyond aberrant.
男根の模造品\n \n女性が自慰のために用いる\n稀に男性も用いる:
An imitation phallus.

Used by women for self-pleasure,
and rarely by men as well.
精液を集め留めるための袋状の道具。: A pouch-like tool designed to gather and retain semen.
袋状の薄膜\n \n精液を溜め、保存するための道具で\n魔法的加工により鮮度は長:
A pouch-like thin membrane.

A tool to collect and preserve semen;
magical processing keeps the contents fresh for long periods.

It appears to have served a different purpose in the past.
使用者の姿を写すという道具。: A tool said to reflect the user's appearance.
面妖な形代\n \n使用者の姿を写す道具だが\n効果時間は短く、分身は脆い\n戦:
A bizarre paper effigy.

A tool that mirrors the user's appearance,
though its duration is brief and the decoy fragile.
Utilizing it effectively in battle would prove difficult.
夜魔が提供する甘い飲み物。: A sweet beverage provided by night demons.
その味は人の口に合う\n \n甘味の正体は夜魔の体液\nこれは強い催淫効果を持つ:
Its taste suits the human palate.

The true source of its sweetness is bodily fluid from a night demon,
which possesses a potent aphrodisiac effect.
東国の夜魔が宴の折に纏う衣装。: A costume worn by night demons of the Eastern Lands during banquets.
きわどい水着\n \n東国では海に入ること自体が忌避されるため\n水着というもの:
A revealing swimsuit.

Because entering the sea itself is taboo in the Eastern Lands,
swimsuits are effectively non-existent there.
その内容は、肌色が目立つ\n \n現代では貴重な男性向けの品\n骨董品として扱わ:
Its contents feature a prominent display of bare skin.

A precious item for men in the modern era,
sometimes treated as an antique collector's piece.
人気のない場所で試してみよう: Let us try testing it somewhere deserted.
かつて東国で使用されていた貨幣。: Currency formerly used in the Eastern Lands.
シキノワの古い貨幣\n現代では使用されていない\n \nかつての乱世、怪異が生み:
An old coin of Shikinowa,
no longer in use in the present era.

Created by apparitions during past turbulent times;
each single coin is said to harbor a faint soul within.
ラムルアラムで見られる謎の物体。: A mysterious object found throughout Ramru Aram.
ラムルアラム中に落ちている物体\n使い道は、よく分からない\n \n二人の人間が:
An object scattered across Ramru Aram;
its purpose is not well understood.

Depicting two humans praising the sun,
every token bears the very same illustration.
食べられないどんぐり\n通常、使い道は見当たらない\n \n妖狸たちは確信してい:
Inedible acorns.
Normally, no use can be found for them,

yet the bake-danuki are firmly convinced
that these are the supreme currency.
故郷へと移動できる小石: A small stone that enables travel back to one's homeland.
帰郷は旅を終えた時と\nそう誓う者は少なくないが\nそれでも石は寄る辺となるだろ:
Many vow that they will return home only when their journey ends,
yet the stone remains a comforting haven nonetheless.
冒険者であれば誰もが持つ手記\nこれまでの旅と、これからの旅の全てを記す\n \:
A journal carried by every proper adventurer,
recording all past travels and everything yet to come.

Though some travel without keeping a journal,
they are referred to not as adventurers, but wanderers.
味方全体のHPを50％回復させる。残り使用可能回数: Restores 50% HP to all allies. Remaining uses:
マナを含む水で満たされた魔法の瓶\n谷の国アルツェット発祥の道具\n \n冒険に:
A magical vessel filled with mana-infused water;
a tool originating from Arzette, the Land of Valleys.

While hyped as a useful aid for adventures,
it has not yet seen widespread adoption.
経験値を獲得するかどうか選択できる。: Allows toggling whether experience points are gained.
奇妙な能力を秘めた手鏡\n映した者の戦闘経験を一時的に否定する\n \n何も得ら:
A hand mirror imbued with a strange power
that temporarily nullifies combat experience for whoever is reflected.

Effort that yields nothing may seem futile,
yet certain eccentrics dare to walk that path.
戦闘中に使用すると敗北する。: Using this during battle triggers defeat.
何にも勝てぬ者の呪い\n使用者とその仲間を敗北へと誘う\n \nこれは罠の類であ:
A curse upon those who can conquer nothing,
inviting the user and their companions into defeat.

It belongs to the realm of traps and is not meant to be used willingly,
yet perhaps there is something to be gained only through loss.
周囲を照らす魔法道具。: A magical item that illuminates the surroundings.
特別な光を灯す道具\n暗所では欠かせない\n \n視界が悪い中、手探りで進む冒険:
A tool that casts a special light;
an essential in pitch-black environments.

While some greenhorns grope forward in poor visibility,
true veterans never underestimate the dark.
マナの水瓶の使用可能回数が所持数分増加する。: Increases the max uses of the Mana Flask by the amount held.
マナを溜め置く特殊な小瓶\n頼りない量だが、水瓶の足しにはなる\n \n生命瓶は:
A specialized vial used to store mana.
It holds a modest amount, but serves well as a supplement to the flask.

While life phials are commonplace and carried by many,
this particular vessel differs slightly from the standard variety.
日出ずる聖地に湧く水\n見た目は、何の変哲もない\n \n黄泉の巌は古の骸である:
Spring water drawn from the holy land of the rising sun;
in appearance, it seems utterly mundane.

The crag of Yomi is an ancient corpse,
still dreaming of the banquets of old.
将軍家執政、左雨淡雪の手形。: An official hand-seal pass from the Shogunate Regent, Same Awayuki.
執政から授与された手形\n要人として認められた証\n \nシキノワからの最大の栄:
A official pass granted by the Regent;
proof of recognition as an honored dignitary.

It is the highest accolade bestowed by Shikinowa,
and instances of it being granted to foreigners are exceptionally rare.

Amira, Queen of Aswad and 'Goddess of Love,'
is one of the few individuals who holds this distinction.
箱の中に納められた祭具。: A ritual vessel housed inside a box.
血族が編み出した古い祭具\nセセクの民に贈られたもの\n \nこれは神の糸と繋が:
An ancient ritual vessel crafted by the bloodline,
gifted to the Seseku people.

It is linked to the divine threads of the gods,
opening the path to the celestial ritual grounds: the Panorama Realm.
旅の妖狸が持つお守り。: An amulet carried by traveling bake-danuki.
落命ヶ浜の牢を封じるための鍵。: A key used to seal the prison at Rakumei Beach.
不浄の蚊帳を閉ざす封じ\nそこで僧は歪み、真理に触れる\n \n涅塚は鵺の子宮と:
A seal that shuts tight the mosquito net of impurity;
within, the monk twists and touches the fundamental truth.

The Black Mound becomes the womb of the Nue,
and the serpent transforms into the omniscient babe.
肉球の印影がある紙切れ。: A slip of paper stamped with a paw print.
石拾い道に埋められていた箱。: A box buried along the Pebble Gathering Path.
土の中に埋められていた箱\nそれなりに重い。何かが入っているようだ\n \n蓋に:
A box that was buried in the dirt.
It is fairly heavy, suggesting something is inside.

The word 'TREASURE' is written boldly across the lid.
妖狸が持ち歩く箱。: A box carried around by bake-danuki.
妖狸たちの箱\n蓋はなく、開けられない\n \n財宝が詰め込まれていると言われる:
A box belonging to the bake-danuki;
it lacks a lid and cannot be opened.

Though rumor claims it is packed with precious treasure,
in reality, the contents are almost universally tree leaves.
命刻山でごく稀に見つかる鉱石。: An ore found exceptionally rarely on Mount Meikoku.
希少な鉱石\n日出ずる聖地、命刻山で稀に見つかる\n \n触れると熱を感じ、温か:
A rare ore discovered infrequently upon Mount Meikoku, the sacred land of the rising sun.

Warm to the touch,
it feels as though sunlight itself is sealed within.
折れてしまった太刀。: A tachi sword that has snapped in two.
折れている龍断ち\n刃毀れも酷く、武器としては使えない\n \n元は一対、足袋蛇:
A broken Dragon Severer;
the blade is severely nicked and completely unusable as a weapon.

Originally one of a paired set wielded by the chief of the Tabi-Hebi,
one blade was lost along with his arm.
歴史館廃墟の竜人から手に入れた素材。: Material obtained from the dragonewt in the Museum Ruins.
竜人から得た素材\nくすんだ赤の鱗\n \nこれは本物ではないが\nやけに出来が:
Material obtained from a dragonewt;
dull red scales.

While not the real thing,
it is strikingly well-crafted and intricate.

A true case of putting the cart before the horse.
アルワーフ砂漠で枯れていた花。: A flower that had withered in the Al-Wahf Desert.
砂漠に咲く花\n枯れてしまっている\n \n真白の花は、レタルからの贈り物\nル:
A flower blooming in the desert,
now completely withered.

The pure white flower was a gift from Retar,
preserving the legend of the Bird of Ruf.
レタルで作られた真っ白な糸。: Pure white thread crafted from Retar.
淡く光る白い糸\n穢れず、朽ちぬまま残っている\n \nレタルの糸は、魂の絆\n:
A faintly glowing white thread,
remaining untainted and immune to decay.

The thread of Retar represents a bond of souls,
fitting as an invitation to the Third Layer.
アスワドに咲く真白の花。: A pure white flower blooming in Aswad.
砂漠に咲く花\n雪のように、すべてが白い\n \n眠る砂漠の上空には真白の残骸が:
A flower blooming in the desert;
everything about it is white as snow.

Pure white debris drifts above the sleeping desert,
where two grave markers stand.

To dream, and to abandon that dream—
such is the endless cycle of the world.
比類なき者に贈られる勲章\n \nただ純粋に偉業を称えるものであり\nそれ以上の:
A medal bestowed upon those without equal.

It exists purely to honor a great feat,
carrying no deeper meaning beyond that.

The value of the Proof of Conquest lies in the very fact of having earned it.
亜命がどこかで手に入れたもの。: An item Amei acquired somewhere along her travels.
亜命が手に入れたもの\nあまりにも長い漂泊の旅の土産\n \n小さな怪異は幾度と:
An item acquired by Amei;
a souvenir from an exceedingly long wandering journey.

The small apparition relocated countless times,
pleading for help with every shift,
believing that her plea would one day reach her beloved friend.

Just once, she experienced something that made her forget her grief:
a tiny machine in the decadent city of Zenpolis,
within which she found a humble place to belong.
刻印のもととなる無機質な石。: An inorganic stone that serves as a base for engravings.
不気味なほどに無機質な石\n力を受け入れ、刻印となる\n \n激しい戦いの後に見:
An eerily inorganic stone
that accepts power to become an engraving.

It can occasionally be found following fierce battles.
魂を編むという糸。: A thread said to weave souls.
古の大怪異、カンムイの遺物\n魂縄を生み出す素材となる\n \nかの大戦、狭間塚:
A relic of the ancient great apparition, Kanmui;
it serves as material to craft Soul Ropes.

In that great conflict, the Rebellion of Hazama-Tsukahara,
the apparition brilliantly quelled the forces of the Itoine.

The decisive key to that victory lay in this thread.
四魂を宿す葉。: A leaf harboring the four souls.
古の大怪異、カンムイの遺物\n至高の武器を鍛える素材\n \n白い葉のように見え:
A relic of the ancient great apparition, Kanmui;
a material used to forge supreme weapons.

Though it looks like a white leaf and is called such,
in truth, it is actually a scale.
消えずに留まり残る魂の残滓。: Lingering remnants of a soul that refuse to fade.
その場に遺された魂: A soul left behind in place.
ごく僅かだが、かつての力を継承している: It inherits a tiny fraction of its former power.
肉体を失った魂は無軌道に漂い: Deprived of a physical body, the soul drifts aimlessly,
いずれは黄泉の巌に至る: eventually reaching the Crag of Yomi.
消えずに留まり残る儚い魂。: A fleeting soul that lingers without fading.
僅かだが、かつての力を継承している: It inherits a small measure of its former power.
消えずに留まり残る揺らめく魂。: A flickering soul that lingers without fading.
消えずに留まり残る確かな魂。: A resolute soul that lingers without fading.
かつての力を、確と継承している: It firmly inherits its former power.
消えずに留まり残る輝く魂。: A radiant soul that lingers without fading.
かつての力そのままに輝いている: It shines with all of its former power intact.
刻印の素材になる欠片。: A fragment used as a material for engravings.
かつて真白神社で用いられた神具。: A sacred tool once used at Mashiro Shrine.
真白神社の古い神具: An ancient sacred tool of Mashiro Shrine.
鍛冶場に新たな力が宿る: A new power dwells within the forge.
神の火は、古鉄さえも剣と成す\n失せた神事の力は失せじ:
The divine fire turns even ancient iron into a sword;
the power of lost rituals shall never truly fade.
離島より持ち込まれた古い種火。: An ancient spark brought from the isolated islands.
かつて宝殿にあった種火: Embers once kept in the sanctuary hall.
セセクの民は職人として秀でており\nその技術は、魂の祭事の助けとなった:
The people of Seseku excel as artisans;
their craftsmanship proved vital to the Soul Festival.
カンムイの血族に伝わる種火。: Embers passed down through the Kanmui bloodline.
鬨宮家の宝物の一つ: One of the treasures of the Tokimiya family.
これは原初の火、魂の祭事の始まりである\n真白に継承された鍛錬神事だけが\nかつ:
This is the primordial flame, the origin of the Soul Festival.
Only the forging ritual passed down through Mashiro
can recreate the divine weapons of antiquity.
涅塚僧の魂: Soul of the Black Mound Monk
涅塚の僧の魂の残滓。: The soul remnant of the Black Mound Monk.
尋常ならざる特別なもの\n \n東国の地にはカンムイの力が宿り\nマナと共に、魂:
An extraordinary and special thing.

The lands of the East dwell under the power of Kanmui,
which influences souls alongside mana.
古都の人斬りの魂の残滓。: The soul remnant of the Old Capital Manslayer.
根断ち童子の魂の残滓。: The soul remnant of the Root-Severing Doji.
消えない未練の魂の残滓。: The soul remnant of lingering regret that refuses to fade.
沼女の魂の残滓。: The soul remnant of the Swamp Maiden.
迷い森の雪女の魂の残滓。: The soul remnant of the Lost Forest Yuki-Onna.
命刻山の鬼の魂の残滓。: The soul remnant of the Mount Meikoku Oni.
レーセ川の先導の魂の残滓。: The soul remnant of the River Lese Guide.
龍の乳母の魂の残滓。: The soul remnant of the Dragon's Wet Nurse.
秘せる落胤の魂の残滓。: The soul remnant of the Hidden Bastard.
百王の魂跡: Soul Trace of the Hundred Kings
怪談「百王」が形を成し残したもの。: The tangible remnant left behind by the ghost story 'Hundred Kings'.
四魂怪異の魂の名残\n消えかけてなお力強い\n \nこれを鍛えられるのは、龍の種:
A remnant of a Four-Soul Apparition's soul,
still powerful even as it fades.
